run_model_on_video: run a PyTorch crash detection model on video frames and save annotated output video
test_frame_with_model: test a single video frame through a loaded PyTorch model using the Tester class
annotate_frame_with_model_output: draw vertical lines on video frames based on model prediction output values
load_pytorch_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint file and wrap it in a Tester instance
write_annotated_video: write annotated video frames to an output AVI file using cv2.VideoWriter
